title: wg: partial-02 L356 For PublicMessage and PrivateMessage, nothing requires...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-partial (partial-02), Sender-Authenticated Messages. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-partial at 7fef7c1, L356.

Text: "Before using the `sender_membership_proof` to verify the included message, a client
processing a SenderAuthenticatedMessage MUST verify that the proof is valid
relative to the group's tree hash for the epoch in which the message was sent."

Problem: For PublicMessage and PrivateMessage, nothing requires Sender.leaf_index to equal sender_membership_proof.leaf_index. Member Y can send a message whose Sender claims leaf X, sign it with Y's key and attach Y's valid proof. A partial client that attributes the message by Sender.leaf_index accepts it as coming from X.

Suggested fix: Require that the sender be of type `member` with `leaf_index` equal to `sender_membership_proof.leaf_index` (and, for GroupInfo, that `signer` equal it), and reject otherwise.

Severity: high. Verifier: keep (Confirmed. The Sender/proof leaf_index binding is required only for Commits (line 489) and GroupInfo (line 398). Section 5 (lines 356-361) has no such check for PublicMessage or PrivateMessage. A full client gets the binding implicitly because it looks the key up at Sender.leaf_index, and any member can produce a PrivateMessage under another leaf's secret-tree keys.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
